name: machjs-monorepo
description: machjs — a small, typed Mealy state machine for TypeScript, the inspector that draws it, and the examples

scripts.build: npm run build -w @evgkch/machjs && npm run build -w @evgkch/machjs-inspector && npm run build -w examples
scripts.dev:examples: npm run build -w @evgkch/machjs && npm run build:lib -w @evgkch/machjs-inspector && npm run dev -w examples
scripts.dev:inspector: npm run build -w @evgkch/machjs && npm run dev -w @evgkch/machjs-inspector
